name: VCU100 — 日本の工場で使う日本語 (Factory Japanese)
license: Original ISHIDA MULTILANG editorial text (2026); industrial vocabulary cross-checked with MHLW glossary.
notes: 179 factory Japanese terms with kana and romanization; independent from the core JA vocabulary.
PT-BR companion required for study in Brazilian Portuguese.
Grammar/politeness of operational phrases needs further native-language QA, not auto-conjugated.
